Light emitting from high-contrast OLED displays behaves differently than ink on paper. When displaying pure white text `#FFFFFF` on absolute black `#000000`, thin serif fonts can appear to bleed or glow outward, a phenomenon known as halation.
Download Docker Desktop from offical source.

content.code:
# Update system packages, install Docker and Docker Compose, then enable and start the Docker service,
# and add the current user to the 'docker' group to run Docker commands without sudo.
sudo pacman -Syu docker docker-compose && sudo systemctl enable --now docker.service && sudo usermod -aG docker $USER

content.text: To counteract halation and maintain effortless legibility, soft off-white text (`#E5E5E5` or `#F0F0F0`) paired with slightly increased line spacing (`1.7` to `1.85`) produces optimal optical balance.
Good typography is invisible; great dark mode typography is effortless.
